scope: Second live orphan-process cleanup after branch consolidation. This receipt covers only processes from obsolete Lapis test worktrees and temporary fixtures; it does not modify or stop installed Lapis.app sessions, their Codex app servers, or the phone gateway.
method: Selected exact process IDs after a live command-line inventory.
Sent SIGTERM to 15 processes in the four obsolete fixture trees.
Waited two seconds and verified all 15 had exited.
Re-ran the Lapis process inventory; only installed Lapis.app sessions and the phone gateway remained.
preserved: Two installed Lapis.app Codex session service trees and their app servers.
checks: Post-cleanup ps inventory found no processes referencing the four removed fixture paths.
The previous 18-process cleanup is recorded separately in evidence/branch-consolidation-20261009.json.
non_claims: This does not prove process-leak root causes fixed on current main, qualify service shutdown behavior, or modify installed Lapis.app state.
